name: Metal Fickert 140
summary: Metal-bond diamond Fickert for fast first-stage grinding on granite line polishers.
description: Diamond segments in a metal bond, mounted on a standard 140 mm Fickert. Used for the first grinding passes on granite slabs and tiles on automatic line polishers. It opens up the surface quickly after sawing or calibrating, so the resin Fickerts that follow have less work to do.

name: Resin Fickert 140
summary: Resin-bond diamond Fickert for smoothing and polishing granite on line polishers.
description: Diamond in a resin bond on a standard 140 mm Fickert. Used after the metal-bond stage to take out scratches and build gloss on granite slabs and tiles. Work through the grit sequence on automatic line polishers.

name: 8" Resin Bond Diamond Plate
summary: 200 mm resin-bond diamond plate for polishing stone floors.
description: A resin-bonded diamond plate for floor polishing machines. Used in grit sequence to polish granite and other stone floors after grinding.

name: 8" Buff Plate
summary: 200 mm buffing plate for the final shine on stone floors.
description: A buffing plate used as the last step after diamond polishing, to bring marble, granite and other stone floors to a deep, even shine.
features: For marble, granite and stone floors

name: R1 Diamond Fickert Brushes
summary: Diamond-filament Fickert brushes for leathered and antique finishes on granite.
description: Abrasive filament brushes on a Fickert body for automatic line polishers. They are used to give granite a textured leathered or antique finish instead of a high polish. Supplied in several colour-coded grades, used from coarse to fine.
features: Fits Fickert heads on line polishers

name: Densi-Hard Sodium Silicate
summary: Economical liquid densifier that hardens and dustproofs concrete and terrazzo floors.
description:
A sodium silicate densifier for concrete and terrazzo. It reacts in the surface layer to give a hard floor that grinds and polishes well. Its larger molecules fill pores efficiently, so less product is needed. It reduces dusting and efflorescence, improves abrasion resistance, and cuts wear on diamond tools.

Suited to interior and exterior concrete, polished concrete, warehouses, factories, food storage areas, and commercial and residential floors. Cover nearby metal, brick, wood, glass and painted surfaces before spraying.
features: Reduces efflorescence and diamond tool wear

specs.label: Coverage
specs.value: 20 to 60 sq ft per litre, depending on porosity

name: Densi-Hard Lithium Silicate
summary: Deep-penetrating lithium densifier for harder, dust-free, more reflective concrete and terrazzo.
description: A lithium silicate densifier for concrete and terrazzo. Its small molecules penetrate deep, hardening the floor so it grinds and polishes well and stays reflective for longer. It makes concrete dustproof, improves abrasion resistance, reduces efflorescence, and cuts wear on diamond tools, lowering long-term maintenance costs.
features: Reduces efflorescence and diamond tool wear

specs.label: Coverage
specs.value: 20 to 60 sq ft per litre, depending on porosity

name: Stain Protector Concentrate
summary: Water-based guard for polished concrete and terrazzo that resists stains and burnishes to a high gloss.
description:
A breathable sealer that partly penetrates and partly forms a film. It gives polished concrete and cement terrazzo a water-resistant barrier against stains and etching, leaving time to clean up spills. It deepens the floor's colour, protects against UV and makes cleaning easier.

Dilute 1:1 with water and test a small area first. Mist it on and spread it evenly with a microfibre mop. When tack-free, burnish with a 3000-grit or finer pad. Apply a second coat the same way, plus a third in heavy-spill areas.

specs.label: Coats
specs.value: 2, each burnished with a 3000-grit or finer pad

specs.label: Traffic
specs.value: Foot traffic when tack-free, equipment after 24 hours

name: Floor Cleaning & Polishing Pads
summary: Colour-coded floor machine pads for stripping, scrubbing, buffing and polishing.
description: A full set of non-woven pads for single-disc machines and scrubbers, colour-coded by job. Black pads strip old finishes. Blue pads handle heavy scrubbing. Red pads cover daily cleaning, spray buffing and crystallising. White pads give the final polish and buff.

specs.label: Range
specs.value: Black stripper, Blue cleaning, Red buffer, White polishing

name: Single Disc Diamond Polisher 2 HP
summary: Single-disc machine for diamond polishing, buffing and scrubbing marble floors.
description: A versatile single-disc floor machine for diamond polishing, buffing and scrubbing marble floors. It comes with hard and soft brushes and a pad driver, so one machine covers polishing and daily cleaning.
features: Supplied with hard and soft brushes and a pad driver

specs.label: Includes
specs.value: Hard brush, soft brush, pad driver, grinding and polishing plate
